SELECT prcp.asmt_ptcp_inst_sn, prcp.asmt_sn, prcp.inst_id, prcp.brno, prcp.ptcp_prgrs_stts_cd, prcp.asmt_rqstr_id, prcp.asmt_dmnd_dt, prcp.asmt_ptcp_agre_id, prcp.asmt_ptcp_agre_dt, prcp.asmt_rslt_reg_id, prcp.asmt_rslt_reg_dt, prcp.asmt_ptcp_rtrcn_id, mbr_rtrcn.encpt_mbr_flnm AS asmt_ptcp_rtrcn_mbr_encpt_flnm, emp_rtrcn.emp_nm AS asmt_ptcp_rtrcn_emp_nm, prcp.asmt_ptcp_rtrcn_rsn, prcp.asmt_ptcp_rtrcn_dt, prcp.del_yn, prcp.rgtr_id, mbr.encpt_mbr_flnm AS mbr_encpt_flnm, emp.emp_nm AS emp_nm, prcp.reg_dt, prcp.mdfr_id, prcp.mdfcn_dt, prcp.uld_type_cd AS uld_type_cd, uld.uld_inst_prgrs_stts_cd, inst.inst_nm, inst.brno,
COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kids_own.TB_CM_M_FILE_ULD file WHERE file.pst_sn = uld.pblnt_sn AND file.ptcp_inst_sn = uld.ptcp_inst_sn AND file.file_se_cd = '07' AND (file.del_yn IS NULL OR file.del_yn = 'N') ), 0) as uld_file_cnt, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kids_own.TB_CM_E_OPNN opnn INNER JOIN kids_own.TB_CM_E_ASMT_META meta ON opnn.asmt_meta_rslt_sn = meta.asmt_meta_rslt_sn AND opnn.asmt_sn = meta.asmt_sn AND meta.rslt_group_cd = '02' WHERE opnn.asmt_sn = prcp.asmt_sn AND opnn.inst_id = prcp.inst_id AND (opnn.utlz_agre_se_cd = '08' OR (opnn.utlz_agre_se_cd = '06' AND opnn.asmt_opnn_stts_cd = '08')) AND (opnn.del_yn IS NULL OR opnn.del_yn = 'N') ), 0) as opnn_agre_cnt, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kids_own.TB_CM_E_OPNN opnn INNER JOIN kids_own.TB_CM_E_ASMT_META meta ON opnn.asmt_meta_rslt_sn = meta.asmt_meta_rslt_sn AND opnn.asmt_sn = meta.asmt_sn AND meta.rslt_group_cd = '04' WHERE opnn.asmt_sn = prcp.asmt_sn AND opnn.inst_id = prcp.inst_id AND opnn.asmt_opnn_stts_cd = '10' AND (opnn.del_yn IS NULL OR opnn.del_yn = 'N') ), 0) as opnn_notuse_cnt FROM kids_own.TB_CM_M_ASMT_PRCP prcp LEFT JOIN kids_own.TB_PP_M_MBR_INFO mbr ON prcp.rgtr_id = mbr.mbr_no LEFT JOIN kids_own.TB_PP_M_EMP_INFO emp ON prcp.rgtr_id = emp.emp_no LEFT JOIN kids_own.TB_PP_M_MBR_INFO mbr_rtrcn ON prcp.asmt_ptcp_rtrcn_id = mbr_rtrcn.mbr_no LEFT JOIN kids_own.TB_PP_M_EMP_INFO emp_rtrcn ON prcp.asmt_ptcp_rtrcn_id = emp_rtrcn.emp_no LEFT JOIN ( SELECT u.inst_id, u.pblnt_sn, u.ptcp_inst_sn, u.uld_inst_prgrs_stts_cd, u.uld_type_cd FROM ( SELECT u1.inst_id, u1.pblnt_sn, u1.ptcp_inst_sn, u1.uld_inst_prgrs_stts_cd, u1.uld_type_cd, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY u1.inst_id ORDER BY u1.reg_dt DESC, COALESCE(u1.mdfcn_dt, u1.reg_dt) DESC, u1.ptcp_inst_sn DESC ) as rn FROM kids_own.TB_CM_M_ULD_PRST u1 WHERE (u1.del_yn IS NULL OR u1.del_yn = 'N') AND u1.inst_id IS NOT NULL ) u WHERE u.rn = 1 ) uld ON prcp.inst_id = uld.inst_id LEFT JOIN kids_own.TB_PP_M_INST inst ON prcp.inst_id = inst.brno

AND (opnn.del_yn IS NULL OR opnn.del_yn = 'N') ), 0) as opnn_agre_cnt, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kids_own.TB_CM_E_OPNN opnn INNER JOIN kids_own.TB_CM_E_ASMT_META meta ON opnn.asmt_meta_rslt_sn = meta.asmt_meta_rslt_sn AND opnn.asmt_sn = meta.asmt_sn AND meta.rslt_group_cd = '04' WHERE opnn.asmt_sn = prcp.asmt_sn AND opnn.inst_id = prcp.inst_id
AND opnn.asmt_opnn_stts_cd = #{asmtOpnnSttsCd}
AND 1 = 0
AND (opnn.del_yn IS NULL OR opnn.del_yn = 'N') ), 0) as opnn_notuse_cnt FROM kids_own.TB_CM_M_ASMT_PRCP prcp LEFT JOIN kids_own.TB_PP_M_MBR_INFO mbr ON prcp.rgtr_id = mbr.mbr_no LEFT JOIN kids_own.TB_PP_M_EMP_INFO emp ON prcp.rgtr_id = emp.emp_no LEFT JOIN kids_own.TB_PP_M_MBR_INFO mbr_rtrcn ON prcp.asmt_ptcp_rtrcn_id = mbr_rtrcn.mbr_no LEFT JOIN kids_own.TB_PP_M_EMP_INFO emp_rtrcn ON prcp.asmt_ptcp_rtrcn_id = emp_rtrcn.emp_no LEFT JOIN ( SELECT u.inst_id, u.pblnt_sn, u.ptcp_inst_sn, u.uld_inst_prgrs_stts_cd, u.uld_type_cd FROM ( SELECT u1.inst_id, u1.pblnt_sn, u1.ptcp_inst_sn, u1.uld_inst_prgrs_stts_cd, u1.uld_type_cd, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY u1.inst_id ORDER BY u1.reg_dt DESC, COALESCE(u1.mdfcn_dt, u1.reg_dt) DESC, u1.ptcp_inst_sn DESC ) as rn FROM kids_own.TB_CM_M_ULD_PRST u1 WHERE (u1.del_yn IS NULL OR u1.del_yn = 'N') AND u1.inst_id IS NOT NULL ) u WHERE u.rn = 1 ) uld ON prcp.inst_id = uld.inst_id LEFT JOIN kids_own.TB_PP_M_INST inst ON prcp.inst_id = inst.brno WHERE prcp.asmt_sn = #{asmtSn} AND prcp.inst_id = #{instId} AND (prcp.del_yn IS NULL OR prcp.del_yn = 'N') ORDER BY prcp.reg_dt DESC
